critique: The draft is accurate, keeps the structure, links and frontmatter intact, and contains no dashes. Its problems are local. A few sentences are clumsy or ungrammatical calques, especially the closing two sentences and "то, кто ты".

The main problem is the Russian copula dash. Terminology, links, frontmatter fields and structure are otherwise sound.

Gender handling, terminology, dashes, links and frontmatter are clean.
